definitions.explanation: More than half of something; the largest portion of a group or quantity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大半|たいはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The majority of participants were students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大半|たいはん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{費|つい}やす→費やす：noentry⟧。
examples.english: I spend most of my time reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大半|たいはん}⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: Most of the work is finished.

notes:
{大半|たいはん} means "the majority" or "most of" something, typically indicating more than 50%.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{大半|たいはん} (the majority of ~)
- {大半|たいはん}が〜 (most are ~)
- {大半|たいはん}は〜 (for the most part, ~)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ほとんど: almost all, nearly (closer to 90-100%)
- {大部分|だいぶぶん}: the greater part (similar to {大半|たいはん})
- {過半数|かはんすう}: majority (specifically more than half, often in voting)
- {大多数|だいたすう}: the great majority

NUANCE:
- {大半|たいはん} suggests roughly 60-80%
- It's less absolute than ほとんど but clearly more than half
